profile.headline: Cloud Security & DevOps Lead
profile.summary: Associate Application Developer working on U.S. government websites including identitytheft.gov, ftccomplaintassistant.gov, and econsumer.gov. Proficient in the use of Anguler 4+ and .Net Core using typescript, javascript, c#, and html as well as using Splunk to monitor application logs.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Development lead on FTCComplaintAssistant.gov enhancements including: html/views, models, controllers, C# model validation, on-page javascript functions
Lead creation of proof of concept to modernize antiquated CRM using Angular and cloud technologies to ensure website longevity
Streamlined development by creating an Amazon AWS Code Pipeline to test, build, and deploy code as it is checked in to a Git-integrated repository
Developed proof of concept chatbot in AWS Lex with integrated AWS Lambda functions to handle three distinct use-cases
Monitor application logs using Splunk to track and quarantine potential malicious user actions and find and correct application vulnerabilities
Build, maintain, and enhance existing applications including identitytheft.gov, ftccomplaintassistant.gov, and econsumer.gov to aid consumers in correcting cases of fraud and identity theft
Write and update automated testing suite to ensure proper functionality of current and new applications
Received a Special Recognition Award from the FTC for dedicated service and extraordinary efforts in supporting IDT.gov, Complaint Assistant development, and Call Center support
